purpose: Empirical registration of the pristine comet-0.5.0 same-Run recovery faces BEFORE the 3_3.mjs assertions were written: every code below was observed live against the real CLI in a one-shot /tmp world (the world is disposable by design; this record is the durable registration).

environment.cometBuildFingerprintSource: integrations/comet/upstream.lock.json (aeb1a659 + patch 0005; build de39629a… resolved at run time — never a pinned value in artifacts)
environment.worldWiring: project with .comet/config.yaml (classic, artifact_layout docs) + git repo; composition package snapshotted into the world; node_modules/@rpamis/comet symlink to the pinned build work/ directory — the same wiring `comet application install` creates via ensureApplicationRuntimeDependency (no install is claimed)
environment.runStoreLocation: <HOME>/.comet/workspaces/<workspace-id>/runtime/applications/sdd-managed-delivery/.runtime-store-v2/<hash>/checkpoint.json (ApplicationRunRecord: runId, revision, application identity incl. contentHash, full SDK run)

startRecipe.initialState: full canonical classic-full camelCase state with isolation:'current' (every schema field required; snake_case wire keys are rejected)
startRecipe.entryAction: classic.composition.prepare (call_tool, engine executor comet-classic-composition-prepare; its validator pins the outcome to that executor's engine-computed work proposal — hosts cannot forge it)
startRecipe.afterPrepare: classic.composition.confirm ask_user wait (resolve-wait approved → full.open scheduled)

observedFaces.result: returns the existing run (inspect); no second checkpoint; different input on the same runId → RUN_CONFLICT ('该 Run 标识已绑定不同工作流或输入')

observedFaces.probe: claim by a second executor/token while claimed
claim replay with the same executor+token while running

observedFaces.result: refused STALE_ACTION (engine-level, before any business validator)
refused STALE_ACTION ('执行尝试或输入版本与当前 Action 不一致')
attempt+1, status pending, dead claim cleared; reconciliations recorded

observedFaces.probe: resolve-wait replay with the identical decision
resolve-wait with a different decision on a resolved wait
one packaged byte drifts (any face: next or inspect)
observedFaces.result: refused WORKFLOW_CHANGED ('应用定义、执行/验证绑定、Skill 或工作区归属发生变化；请恢复原应用包和依赖后继续原 Run'); restoring the original bytes resumes the SAME run

observedFaces.probe: execute (trusted executor) over a host-claimed action
observedFaces.result: refused ACTION_ALREADY_CLAIMED ('不能重复执行已派发的 Action；请先查询和核对结果')
refused REVISION_CONFLICT ('Run 已变化，请重新读取当前状态')

observedFaces.probe: refused mutation CLI response (compact output, application-file face)
observedFaces.result: response carries continuation { mode:'reconcile', request:{ operation:'inspect', runId }, commandArgs: runtime dispatch --application-file … --details, instruction: '读取当前 Run 后按其合法续行处理，不盲目重试原写入' } — the classic composition recovery request surface

observedFaces.probe: classic run_checkpoint recovery request (pristine source reading, not live in this slice)
observedFaces.result: the classic SDK state store names Recovery request { operation:'next', runId } — recovery restores the recorded state and advances only the Runtime; the composition-Run faces above are the live-probed subset
comet state init <change> full --managed-delivery … refuses with a usage error — the honest RED that retired the previous L11-core-transaction/fencing slice (recorded in the P3_3 worker report)

boundary: Probe worlds are one-shot /tmp directories (isolated HOME/TMPDIR/PATH). No live configuration, no repo control-plane file and no composition package byte was mutated; the drift probe mutated only the world's private package snapshot and restored it inside the same probe.
